.PHONY: test test-fast

test-fast:
	pytest -m "not postgres" -q

test:
	pytest -q

To run only the fast tests, skip the Postgres-marked ones:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That is what the `test-fast` target ran. The full suite (`pytest -q`) also runs the Postgres integration tests, so it needs a database. Start one first with `docker compose up db`.

I can't confirm the `just` side from this checkout. `Makefile` is still in the repo root and there is no `justfile`, so the removal may be on another branch or not committed here. I don't know what your fast recipe is called. If you have a justfile elsewhere, it is probably something like `just test-fast` wrapping the command above. Check with `just --list`.

The stored project memory still says to use `make test-fast` and `make test`. I haven't changed it, because I'd be guessing at the new recipe names. Once you confirm them, I can update it.
